instrument.pairAlreadyUsed: This base/quote pair is already used by {{feeds}}

instrumentDialog.ibDescription: Choose a resolved contract or fill the contract fields manually before adding the instrument.

create.title: Add {{provider}} source
create.defaultHint: Create a source, then add instruments to it.
create.duplicateLabel: A source with this name already exists.
create.binanceHint: Create a Binance source for live spot prices. No credentials are needed for public ticker streams.
create.byoHint: Create a manual source. After creation, add instruments and send operator-maintained prices.
create.mockHint: Create a synthetic source for demos and local tests.

ib.title: Interactive Brokers
ib.description: Live market data from Interactive Brokers TWS or IB Gateway. Use contract settings when a plain symbol is ambiguous.
ib.createHint: Create an Interactive Brokers source connected to TWS/Gateway. Configure host, port, client ID, and market-data mode.

binance.title: Binance
binance.description: Live spot-market prices streamed from Binance. External symbols use Binance notation such as BTCUSDT.
binance.createHint: Create a Binance source for live spot prices. No credentials are needed for public ticker streams.

kraken.title: Kraken
kraken.description: Live spot-market prices streamed from Kraken WebSocket v2. External symbols use Kraken pair notation such as BTC/USD.
kraken.createHint: Create a Kraken source for live spot prices. No credentials are needed for public ticker streams.

coinbase.title: Coinbase
coinbase.description: Live product tickers from Coinbase Exchange. External symbols use product IDs such as BTC-USD.
coinbase.createHint: Create a Coinbase source for live exchange tickers. No credentials are needed for the public feed.

alpaca.title: Alpaca
alpaca.description: Live US equity prices from Alpaca IEX. Requires API key credentials; external symbols use stock tickers such as AAPL.
alpaca.createHint: Create an Alpaca source for IEX equity prices. Add the API key and secret.

okx.title: OKX
okx.description: Live spot tickers from OKX. External symbols use OKX instrument IDs such as BTC-USDT.
okx.createHint: Create an OKX source for public spot tickers. No credentials are needed for the public feed.

bybit.title: Bybit
bybit.description: Live tickers from Bybit v5. External symbols use Bybit symbols; category can be configured in credentials.
bybit.createHint: Create a Bybit source for public v5 tickers. Choose the market category.

oanda.title: OANDA
oanda.description: Live FX pricing from OANDA v20. Requires account credentials; external symbols use instruments such as EUR_USD.
oanda.createHint: Create an OANDA source for FX prices. Add the token, account ID, and environment.

finnhub.title: Finnhub
finnhub.description: Live trade prices from Finnhub WebSocket. Requires an API token; external symbols use Finnhub-supported symbols.
finnhub.createHint: Create a Finnhub source for live trade prices. Add the API token.

byo.title: BYO
byo.description: Manual marks maintained by the operator. Use it for static FX, test marks, or feeds that are injected by another system.
byo.createHint: Create a manual source. After creation, add instruments and send operator-maintained prices.

mock.title: Mock
mock.description: Synthetic market data for demos and local testing. It does not connect to an external venue.
mock.createHint: Create a synthetic source for demos and local tests.

restart.requiredTitle: Restart needed to apply market-data changes
restart.requiredDetail: Saved source or instrument settings differ from the running feeds. Restart feeds to apply them.

state.staleTooltip: Quote older than the freshness window

settings.title: Connection settings
settings.editDescription: Blank secret fields keep the stored value. Restart feeds to apply saved connection changes.

resolve.label: Resolve symbol in this feed
resolve.placeholder: Type EUR, EUR/USD, BTC, or AAPL
resolve.noResults: No matching symbols in this feed

deleteInstrument.description: {{symbol}} will be permanently removed from this source.
